description:
You are profiling an application located in the directory /home/user/project. After making a performance improvement, you need to update the version of the application and document the change.

Here is what you should do:

1. Open the file /home/user/project/VERSION. The file currently contains a single line with the text "2.3.4". You must update this to "2.3.5" (bumping only the patch version).
2. Edit the changelog file /home/user/project/CHANGELOG.md. Add a new entry at the top, following this exact format:
   ## [2.3.5] - 2024-06-10
   ### Changed
   - Improved profiling result: reduced function load time by optimizing database query.
Make sure your entry is at the top, above any previous entries.
3. After making these changes, create a log of your actions in a new file called /home/user/project/version_bump.log. The file should contain exactly these two lines, in order:
   Updated VERSION from 2.3.4 to 2.3.5
   Added changelog entry for 2.3.5

Ensure that the files /home/user/project/VERSION, /home/user/project/CHANGELOG.md, and /home/user/project/version_bump.log have the correct contents and formatting as specified above.
